about_the_game:
This value pack is filled with items to enhance your experience in DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2.

Time Patrol Support Pack includes:
- Energy Capsule Z x10
- Power Capsule Z x10
- Aura Capsule Z x10
- Senzu Essence Capsule x5
- Zen-Oh Button x3
- Demon Realm Crystal x5
- Super Mix Capsule Z x5
- Super Attack (Super God Fist, Super Destructo-Disc, Power Pole Combo, Wild Hunt, Kaioken Kamehameha, Big Bang Attack, Death Psycho Bomb, Justice Pose, Maximum Charge, Punisher Guard)
- Ultimate Attack (Warp Kamehameha, Impulse Slash, Giant Storm)
- Costume (Vegito Clothes, Gogeta Clothes, Future Trunks' Clothes (Super), Battle Suit (Bardock), Broly Clothes, Master Korin's Suit, Frieza's Suit (Final Form), Orange Star High School Outfit)
- Accessory (Frieza's Head (Final Form), Korin Wig with Ears & Tail)
- Super Soul (The ultimate power is mine!, I hope you're reborn as someone good this time. You must die by my hand!)
- CC Mascots (Puar)

*Some content can be obtained through the in-game shop or by meeting specific conditions within the game.
*Content will be reflected after it is received from the in-game Timespace Delivery.
*Super and Ultimate Attacks will only be reflected if they are not yet acquired.
*Items exceeding the possession limit will be discarded.
